This suggests that geographic scale can affect the identification and quantification of racial disparities.

However, the completion also mentions that "Additional research is needed before general conclusions can be formulated regarding the choice of optimal geographic regions for the detection of racial disparities." This implies that more research is required to determine which level of geographic analysis is most effective in identifying and addressing racial disparities in breast cancer mortality.

In summary, while geographic scale can affect the identification of racial disparities in breast cancer mortality, it is not clear-cut and may require further investigation.
